title: Menu features report ready while required runtime owners are missing
reproduction: Open Mounts, Market or Appearance from the Luxe menu
Observe load completion and inspect the actual UI and runtime errors
expected: A feature becomes ready only after its ordered dependencies and real owner initialize; failed downloads reject and remain retryable.
actual: Original Mounts logs missing catalog/stats dependency; Market shows only Mercado cargando without close control; Appearance throws CHARACTER_SLOT_SCHEMA_NOT_LOADED. Bag ensure succeeds without Equipment or Containers. Script network errors also resolve successfully.

research.summary: Dependency omissions and false-positive load success are reproduced. Candidate patches restore several features; full menu, WebKit and real iPhone verification remain pending.

known_facts.statement: Network error resolves and marks a pack loaded in the original loader; regression fails before the patch and passes after rejection/retry handling.
Original first-use graphs omit dependencies required at evaluation time.

unknowns.question: Do all menu routes and gameplay systems initialize and remain responsive on WebKit and physical iPhone?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Chromium movement alone does not verify Safari or feature operation.
unknowns.quickest_test: Run the new stability workflow and physical iPhone menu/move/wait/resume QA.

attempt_history.goal: Reproduce first-use failures and candidate dependency fixes

change.summary: Restore Mounts/Bag/Market dependencies, delegate Appearance to its existing launcher, reject failed script loads.

validation.method: Actual menu opening plus movement 8s, rest 10s, resume 4s and runtime owner checks

attempt_history.conclusion: Mounts, Market and Bag candidate cycles passed. Appearance and remaining routes require further validation. This does not demonstrate a fix for the player's original persistent freeze.

next_best_actions.action: Run Chromium/WebKit first-use feature matrix and open/close each real panel before move/rest/resume
next_best_actions.reason: Detect initialization omissions and leaked input locks
next_best_actions.expected_signal: Real owners and panels exist, errors remain empty and movement resumes
next_best_actions.stop_condition: Any route failure requires a targeted dependency/owner fix before certification

notes: Do not mark VERIFIED or use this issue to close BUG-0003; the physical iPhone freeze has not been reproduced/fixed by these patches.
